title: •The Emperor’s Prize
caption: •The Emperor’s Prize (V)
game_text: Unless your {set:ds2} objective on table, deploy on Vader. Target Luke (even at Dagobah). During opponent’s move phase, if Vader present at a battleground site, opponent loses 1 Force. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.
lore: Vader thought that by capturing Luke, he would crush the Alliance’s last hope. But, there was another...

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Emperor’s); wiki page title uses a straight one. Banner UTINNI EFFECT. Inline icon in 'Unless your [icon] objective': a silver sphere with blue and red diagonal reflections = the Death Star II expansion-set icon (matches the Game Aid sheet; stub: 'Death Star II objective') → {set:ds2} (no set-ds2 asset exists yet). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. The wiki's default page is the printed archive face; 'The Emperor's Prize (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set) used as base_page. CC-D-theemperorsprize.gif (350) is the PC errata face ('E' tag, 'deploy on Emperor or…') — downloaded to src/vs6/47-CC-D-theemperorsprize.gif for art only; the decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Alliance’s (wiki straight); the ellipsis is printed as three spaced dots after 'another' (kept as '...'). Copyright 1997 not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2-D-theemperorsprize-pre.gif, 350 px; V5-D-lukeskywalkertheemperorsprize* is a different card).
